generatedFields.world.time: dt, duration, planningWindow, and optional displayUnits such as hours
generatedFields.meta.generationConfig: object used to reproduce generated levels when possible
generatedFields.meta.generationConfig.scenarioSetup: player-selected generated challenge setup: mode, agentCount, grid, durationHours, surfaceIntervalHours, fuelPerAgent, gliderSpeed, difficulty, terrain/hazard/current/star settings
generatedFields.meta.generationConfig.connectivity: connectivity generation settings and latest validation result
generatedFields.meta.connectivity: playability validation summary for deployment-to-water, ROI, and recovery reachability
generatedFields.meta.generationConfig.currentGenerator: object describing parametric or synthetic fluid-inspired current generation
generatedFields.layers.forecast.frames: optional forecast frames with current, roi, and confidence
generatedFields.layers.forecasts: optional ensemble forecast members with id, label, and frames
generatedFields.layers.depth: optional 2D bathymetry grid from shallow 0 to deep 1
generatedFields.layers.mobileHazards: optional mobile hazard objects with timed frames
generatedFields.layers.priorityTargets: optional temporal Gold Star / priority target objects with value, radius, captureMode, and timed frames

zones.compatibility: legacy layers.bases are normalized into deployment zones when explicit zones are absent

optionalEditorFields.missionDefaults: optional anchor.mission object exported by the Environment Editor for custom playable levels
optionalEditorFields.meta.editorConfig: optional editor settings such as last brush, frame scope, and selected frame

currentGenerator.parametric: { type:'parametric', preset:'calm|uniformDrift|shearFlow|currentCorridor|eddyField|doubleGyre|tidalOscillation|stormPulse|islandWake|gulfInspired|chaotic', pattern:string, strength:number, variability:number, seed, temporalEvolution:true, synthetic:true }
currentGenerator.fluid: { type:'fluid', preset:'eddyField|shearFlow|currentCorridor|islandWake|stormPulse', seed, strength, viscosity, iterations, vorticityConfinement, vorticity, stats, synthetic:true }
currentGenerator.stats: { minSpeed, maxSpeed, meanSpeed, medianSpeed, stdSpeed, calmCellRatio, strongCellRatio, classification:'Calm|Gentle|Moderate|Strong|Chaotic', warnings:string[] }
currentGenerator.note: Fluid presets are synthetic gameplay fields generated in-browser; they are not real ocean forecasts, HYCOM output, or a Navier-Stokes solver.

savedRegistry.fallback: If localStorage is unavailable, JSON import/export still works and registry actions report a warning.

priorityTargets.frameShape: { id, label, value, radius, captureMode:'once', frames:[{t,x,y,active}] }
priorityTargets.intervalShape: { id, label, x, y, startTime, endTime, value, radius }
priorityTargets.generationConfig: meta.generationConfig.priorityTargets may include enabled, count, valueRange, probabilityNoStarPerWindow, allowNoStarAtStart, minFirstAppearanceWindow, maxFirstAppearanceWindow, activeWindowDuration, and movementMode.
priorityTargets.behavior: Targets are separate from ROI heatmap cells. Active targets appear only after the current/previous active frame says active:true, can move between frames, and disappear when active:false.

notes: Readable schema-like documentation; validation is lightweight/manual. Generated levels use ocean-inspired synthetic current and forecast fields and remain compatible with static hosting.
